[NSTG.2.2.1] **`cached()` reads engine memory.** The rule uses
`let v = cached("key")`; the engine answers from its own in-engine
cache ([LSTO.4.7.1]) — there is **no get callback**. The read is
synchronous and cannot block or fail for want of a registered
callback; per LSTO.1.1 it is still the **only** sync storage
affordance.
